changeSet.author: itechciv
changeSet.comment: Map OpenELIS units of measure to UCUM codes (only where ucum_code is NULL)
changeSet.sql: UPDATE clinlims.unit_of_measure SET ucum_code = m.ucum FROM (VALUES ('%', '%'), ('Vol%', '%{vol}'), ('10^3/µl', '10*3/uL'), ('10^6/µl', '10*6/uL'), ('Cell/µl', '/uL'), ('/µL', '/uL'), ('μl', 'uL'), ('million/uL', '10*6/uL'), ('K/mm^3', '10*3/mm3'), ('mille/mm^3', '10*3/mm3'), ('mille/mm3', '10*3/mm3'), ('million/mm^3', '10*6/mm3'), ('million/mm3', '10*6/mm3'), ('/mm3', '/mm3'), ('mm3', 'mm3'), ('micron^3', 'um3'), ('fl', 'fL'), ('pg', 'pg'), ('g/dl', 'g/dL'), ('g/dL', 'g/dL'), ('g/l', 'g/L'), ('mg/dl', 'mg/dL'), ('mg/l', 'mg/L'), ('ug/dL', 'ug/dL'), ('ug/l', 'ug/L'), ('ng/mL', 'ng/mL'), ('mmol/l', 'mmol/L'), ('µmol/L', 'umol/L'), ('ml/L', 'mL/L'), ('mL', 'mL'), ('L/24h', 'L/(24.h)'), ('mm/h', 'mm/h'), ('copies/ml', '{copies}/mL'), ('Copies/ml', '{copies}/mL'), ('cp/mL', '{copies}/mL'), ('UI/L', '[iU]/L'), ('u/L', 'U/L'), ('Ul/l', 'U/L'), ('ui/ml', '[iU]/mL'), ('mU/ml', 'mU/mL'), ('mlU/ml', 'm[iU]/mL'), ('sec', 's'), ('secondes', 's'), ('mns', 'min') ) AS m(name, ucum) WHERE clinlims.unit_of_measure.name = m.name AND (clinlims.unit_of_measure.ucum_code IS NULL OR clinlims.unit_of_measure.ucum_code = '');

rollback.sql: UPDATE clinlims.unit_of_measure SET ucum_code = NULL WHERE name IN ('%','Vol%','10^3/µl','10^6/µl','Cell/µl','/µL','μl','million/uL', 'K/mm^3','mille/mm^3','mille/mm3','million/mm^3','million/mm3','/mm3','mm3', 'micron^3','fl','pg','g/dl','g/dL','g/l','mg/dl','mg/l','ug/dL','ug/l','ng/mL', 'mmol/l','µmol/L','ml/L','mL','L/24h','mm/h','copies/ml','Copies/ml','cp/mL', 'UI/L','u/L','Ul/l','ui/ml','mU/ml','mlU/ml','sec','secondes','mns');
